mapper.select: SELECT uf.id, u.id AS userId, u.name, u.zh, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.signature, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_follow uf2 WHERE uf2.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND uf2.following_id = u.id ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isFollowing FROM user_follow uf INNER JOIN sys_user u ON uf.following_id = u.id WHERE uf.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC
